scorecard.name: Verified customer
scorecard.coaching: Agent failed to verify customer identity within the first 240 seconds, omitting requests for PIN, full billing address, or security question.

scorecard.name: Active listening
scorecard.coaching: Agent asked caller to repeat the landline telephone number at [02:30] after the customer had already provided it clearly in his opening turn.

grader.scenario: Landline 1571 voicemail PIN lockout; temporary PIN issued and greeting reconfigured; agent fails verification and active listening
grader.notes: The agent reset a locked 1571 voicemail PIN and guided the customer through setting a new PIN and recording a custom greeting. However, the agent failed Verified Customer by failing to request PIN, address, or security question within the first 240 seconds, and failed Active Listening by asking the caller to restate his landline telephone number 6 minutes into the call despite the customer providing it in his opening turn.

items.name: Verified customer
items.evidence: Agent asked only for account reference number and mother's name in the first 240 seconds, omitting required whole-word 'pin', 'address', or 'security question' verification.

items.name: Active listening
items.evidence: [02:30] Agent: 'Now, could you tell me again what the landline telephone number is?' - Customer had clearly provided '0121 496 0842' in turn 1 [00:07].

items.name: Took ownership of the problem
items.evidence: [07:45] Agent: 'I will remain the dedicated owner for this support ticket, Quinton, and I will keep this case on follow-up monitoring for forty-eight hours.' - Clear personal ownership.

items.name: Build rapport and observed professionalism
items.evidence: [03:42] Agent: 'Obviously security policy prohibits resetting mailbox credentials without generating an encrypted one-time security token...' - Professional, objective explanation.
